class.description: what layer the trap lives in. operations = day-to-day running/scaling/housekeeping (an OOM that only happens at 90% GPU utilisation); security = an attack surface or vulnerability; privacy = data handling, redaction, or what the engine logs about prompts; compliance = licence, export, or regulatory obligations.

affects.description: record ids only (engine, accelerator, quantization or interconnect). Concept, software-stack and model-name references belong in `concepts`.

concepts.description: free-text scope markers that are NOT record ids: decoding or scheduling concepts (kv-cache, prefix-caching, speculative-decoding, tensor-parallel), software stacks (rocm, sycl, oneapi, vulkan, cuda, triton, pytorch), model names, and architecture codenames (hopper-sm90, gfx1100). Not id-resolved.

sources.description: source ids; each must exist in data/sources/
